data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'J-L-L' which means 'to be exalted, to be noble, to be magnificent', Jaleelat is an Arabic name that symbolizes the greatest of virtues - being righteous, noble, and worthy of respect. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jaleelat usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
